headword: {代表取締役|だいひょうとりしまりやく}
reading: だいひょうとりしまりやく
gloss: representative director (legal head of a company)

definitions.gloss: representative director; the director legally authorized to represent a company
definitions.explanation: The director of a Japanese stock company who is legally authorized to act for it. The company's president ({社長|しゃちょう}) usually holds this post, so the two are often printed together on business cards.

examples.japanese: {代表取締役|だいひょうとりしまりやく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{名刺|めいし}→名刺：01090_meishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「{代表取締役社長|だいひょうとりしまりやくしゃちょう}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いてある→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: The business card says "Representative Director and President".

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設立|せつりつ}する→設立する：17473_setsuritsusuru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{代表取締役|だいひょうとりしまりやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦{以上|いじょう}→以上：01308_ijou⟧⟦{決|き}めて→決める：00858_kimeru⟧⟦{登記|とうき}→登記：19798_touki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When you set up a company, you choose at least one representative director and register them.

notes:
A legal title under the Companies Act; ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧ is a job title inside the company. Most presidents are also representative directors, hence {代表取締役社長|だいひょうとりしまりやくしゃちょう}, and a chairman may hold the post as {代表取締役会長|だいひょうとりしまりやくかいちょう}.
